profile.name: Muddusar Zulfiqar
profile.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer — AI & DevOps
profile.tagline: Building full-stack products, AI-powered features, and the DevOps pipelines that ship them
profile.summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 7+ years building fast, scalable web applications end to end — from React/Next.js and Vue/Nuxt frontends through Node.js/Express APIs and MongoDB/PostgreSQL data layers — for international clients and distributed teams. Integrates the Anthropic Claude API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) into production apps, building LLM-powered features with RAG and multi-agent AI workflows, including Claude Code subagent orchestration where specialized agents hand off work as a coordinated team. Owns the DevOps side of delivery too: Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS deployments. Currently a Senior Software Engineer and frontend lead at PureLogics, mentoring a team of 15 engineers and owning delivery from architecture through launch in remote-first, cross-functional environments.

description: Integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude) and MCP tooling into production workflows, building LLM-powered features with RAG and multi-agent AI workflows on the Node.js / React stack.

Run Claude Code subagent workflows in day-to-day delivery — splitting feature work across specialized agents that hand off research, implementation, and review as a coordinated team, cutting iteration time on complex features.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to a team of 15 engineers, raising team-wide code quality and delivery through code reviews, pair programming, and hands-on coaching.

Architect responsive interfaces in React.js, Vue.js, and SCSS, improving Lighthouse performance scores by 25% and reducing page load times by 30% via code splitting, lazy loading, and reusable component architecture.
Own full-stack and DevOps delivery — REST/GraphQL APIs in Node.js/Express with PostgreSQL and MongoDB, containerized with Docker, deployed via CI/CD pipelines to AWS.
Collaborate asynchronously with cross-functional, distributed teams to ship features on schedule in a remote-first environment.
Progressed from Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer, leading frontend development across multiple scalable web applications for international clients.
Built responsive React.js, Vue.js, and SCSS interfaces across client projects; named "Star of the Month" before promotion to Senior in Oct 2023.
Contributed to architectural and strategic decisions across TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, aligning technical solutions with broader business objectives.
Built responsive, high-performance web applications in React.js and Next.js, delivering consistent experiences across devices.
Implemented accessible, multilingual interfaces with strong attention to UI/UX and performance optimization.
Partnered with cross-functional teams to ship goal-aligned frontend solutions and adopt modern workflows.
Delivered frontend development for international clients across 20 projects, building responsive interfaces to high code-quality standards.
Translated client requirements into clean, maintainable React and JavaScript components under tight timelines.
Developed visually polished, responsive user interfaces with React.js, Vue.js, jQuery, and SCSS, maintaining high code-quality standards.
Stayed current with modern tools and techniques to continuously improve delivery quality and consistency.
Built responsive, scalable interfaces with JavaScript, jQuery, and Liquid that integrated cleanly with backend systems.
Contributed to website development and company-profile management, strengthening core web development and communication skills.

projects.title: AI Agent Workflows at PureLogics
projects.description: Production LLM features and a multi-agent delivery workflow built on the Anthropic Claude API and MCP.
projects.longDescription: Integrated the Anthropic Claude API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) into client-facing Node.js/React products to ship LLM-powered features backed by RAG. Alongside that, set up a Claude Code subagent workflow for the team: complex features get split across specialized agents — one researches and plans, another implements, another reviews — handing off work the way a small human team would, which shortened iteration time on multi-step features.
features: Anthropic Claude API + MCP tooling integrated into production Node.js/React apps
RAG pipeline powering LLM-driven features on real product data
Claude Code subagent orchestration: specialized agents collaborate and hand off research, implementation, and review
Rolled the workflow out to the engineering team as part of day-to-day delivery

He is always eager to learn and adapt to new technologies and trends. I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone seeking a dedicated, talented, and results-driven frontend professional.
